literal_meaning: তিলের বীজে তিলের বীজে তাল গাছ
figurative_meaning_en: Gradually accumulating small amounts to form something massive
similar_in_english: Many a mickle makes a muckle
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসা তিলে তিলে তাল হয়ে উঠেছে।
ধৈর্য ধরে কাজ করলে তিলে তিলে তাল গড়ে ওঠে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business grew from sesame to palm tree through steady effort.
With patience, small efforts accumulate to great success.
note: This idiom draws from agricultural imagery common in Bengali rural life, emphasizing incremental progress.
